en.title: thedotmack/claude-mem: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent
en.summary: ⭐ 114,621 | Every time you start a new coding session, your AI agent forgets everything and starts from zero. Claude-Mem solves this by running a **second agent** beside it to take notes, compress activity with AI, and inject **relevant context** back into future sessions. It works seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and many other popular coding tools.

zh.title: thedotmack/claude-mem：为每个AI编程助手提供跨会话的长效记忆
zh.summary: ⭐ 114,621 | 每次开启新的编程会话时，你的AI助手总是会失忆并从零开始。Claude-Mem 通过在旁边运行一个**观察者助手**来记录工作、用AI进行压缩，并在未来会话中自动注入**相关上下文**。它能与 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 等众多主流编程工具完美配合。

en.title: Capital Cools Down on World Models as Venture Throws on the Brakes
en.summary: The venture capital frenzy surrounding AI **world models** has abruptly cooled down after a red-hot summer. Investors are tightening their wallets and raising funding thresholds, making it difficult for concept-driven startups to raise money. Only a handful of elite teams with **top-tier academic backgrounds** and solid research progress are still securing massive checks.

zh.title: 资本正在降温世界模型，VC出手门槛变高了
zh.summary: 曾经红火的AI**世界模型**赛道在下半年迎来急转直下，热钱迅速变少，资本投资门槛显著抬高。靠概念融资的日子已经过去，现在只有极少数具备**顶尖高校背景**和扎实研究成果的创业团队，才能顺利拿到大笔资金。

en.title: GitHub's Next Scaling Challenge: Rebuilding the Software Stack for AI Agent Workloads
en.summary: Microsoft CoreAI EVP Jay Parikh discussed how **GitHub** is scaling its platform—now home to 225 million developers and 34.3 billion commits—to handle a massive influx of agent-driven workloads. He noted that the platform is actively adapting its infrastructure, introducing features like **Copilot Fusion** for model orchestration, and shifting toward measuring AI spending against completed business outcomes rather than raw usage. The discussion highlights an ongoing **industry shift** where software infrastructure must evolve from human-centric version control to multi-client agent coordination.

zh.title: GitHub 的下一个规模挑战：为 AI 代理工作负载重构软件技术栈
zh.summary: 微软 CoreAI 执行副总裁 Jay Parikh 探讨了 **GitHub** 如何扩展其平台（目前拥有 2.25 亿开发者和 34.3 亿次提交）以应对海量的代理驱动工作负载。他指出，该平台正在积极调整基础设施，引入用于模型编排的 **Copilot Fusion** 等功能，并转向根据已完成的业务成果而非单纯使用量来衡量 AI 支出。这次讨论凸显了一个正在进行的**行业转变**，即软件基础设施必须从以人类为中心 版本控制演变为多客户端代理协同。

en.title: AI clog: UK public bodies and businesses are swamped by chatbot-generated complaints
en.summary: UK public bodies and businesses are facing a massive wave of **AI-generated complaints** and letters, a phenomenon dubbed "AI clog." While chatbots like ChatGPT make it super easy for regular people to write formal, professional-sounding grievances, these messages are often **massively long and repetitive**, taking human workers huge amounts of time to read and process despite limited resources.

zh.title: AI堵塞：英国公共机构和企业被大模型生成的投诉信彻底淹没
zh.summary: 英国的政府部门和企业正遭遇大量由人工智能生成的投诉信，这种现象被称为**“AI堵塞”**。虽然聊天机器人让普通人能轻松写出看似专业、长篇大论的投诉或法律文件，但这导致相关机构的工作人员**不堪重负**，因为处理这些冗长且真假参半的内容需要消耗巨大的精力和时间。

en.title: ToyBlocks: A Controlled Simulation Framework for Robot Learning and Evaluation
en.summary: Researchers have introduced **ToyBlocks**, an open simulation framework designed to help robots learn manipulation tasks like stacking and sorting in a controlled setting. By automatically generating training data and testing scenarios, ToyBlocks allows scientists to study why robot models fail and how to improve their **spatial reasoning** and physical control.

zh.title: 玩具积木：一个用于机器人学习和评估的受控仿真框架
zh.summary: 研究人员推出了**玩具积木**（ToyBlocks）开源仿真框架，旨在帮助机器人在受控环境中学习堆叠和分类等操作任务。通过自动生成训练数据和测试场景，该框架让科学家能够研究机器人模型为什么会失败，以及如何提高它们的**空间推理**和物理控制能力。

en.title: Can Startup Founders Survive in the Era of Personal Agents?
en.summary: While big tech companies seem to dominate **Personal Agents**, this article argues that startups still have a chance. The real value of AI is moving beyond foundational models, allowing startups to build **deep relationships** with users through personalized context and specific vertical scenarios rather than just competing on raw computing power.

zh.title: 创业者做 Personal Agent，有没有一线生机？
zh.summary: 虽然大厂在 **Personal Agent** 赛道看似占据优势，但文章认为创业者依然有一线生机。AI 的核心价值正在超越基础模型，创业者可以通过积累 **用户上下文** 和打造垂直场景，在巨头阴影下找到属于自己的生存空间。

en.title: Amazon SageMaker now supports Multi-Instance GPU partitioning for model endpoints
en.summary: Amazon SageMaker Inference now supports NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG), allowing you to **split one physical GPU** into multiple isolated partitions. Instead of wasting money on a full GPU for a small model, you can now **run multiple models** on a single hardware chip with predictable performance and lower costs.

zh.title: 亚马逊云 SageMaker 现在支持多实例 GPU 分区，帮你省钱提效
zh.summary: 亚马逊云 SageMaker 推理服务现在支持英伟达多实例 GPU 功能，允许你把**一块完整的显卡**拆分成多个独立的小分区。这样一来，小型模型就不用独自占用一整张昂贵的显卡了，你可以在单个设备上**塞进多个模型**，既省钱又稳定。

en.title: GitHub, Google, and Siemens Share 15 Design Patterns for AI Agents
en.summary: Tech giants GitHub, Google, and Siemens have pulled together **15 design patterns** for building reliable AI agent systems. These patterns help tackle common headaches like output errors and broken workflows, making it much easier to **run AI agents safely** in the real world.

zh.title: GitHub、谷歌与西门子联合整理：AI智能体设计的15种模式
zh.summary: 科技大厂GitHub、谷歌和西门子联合总结了**15种设计模式**，专门用来打造靠谱的AI智能体系统。这些模式能帮大家解决输出出错、流程卡壳等常见痛点，让**AI智能体落地**变得更加稳妥和简单。

en.title: Silicon Valley Chinese Team Beats DeepSeek to Build Next-Gen Super-Agent
en.summary: DeepSeek recently proposed a super-agent architecture to solve human attention bottlenecks in AI tasks. Surprisingly, a Silicon Valley Chinese team named AFK AI built a similar **router and worker** architecture into their product Comma months ago, enabling long-term memory and **multi-task execution** through a single conversation window.

zh.title: 抢跑DeepSeek！硅谷华人把下一代Agent Harness造出来了
zh.summary: DeepSeek最近提出了超级智能体架构来解决AI任务中的人类注意力瓶颈。让人意外的是，硅谷华人团队AFK AI几个月前就在产品Comma中实现了类似的**主脑加执行者**架构，通过一个对话窗口实现了长期记忆和**多任务并行**处理。

en.title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks
en.summary: Over the past year, developer adoption of NVIDIA's wireless software has grown significantly, helping researchers worldwide build **AI-native 6G networks**. These open source tools are being used to make robots react faster, improve signal reception in tough conditions, cut down network energy use, and speed up testing simulations.

zh.title: 英伟达开源工具助力研究人员打造下一代 6G 网络
zh.summary: 在过去的一年里，英伟达无线软件的开发者采用率大幅增长，帮助全球研究人员打造**人工智能驱动的 6G 网络**。这些开源工具正被用来让机器人反应更快、在恶劣环境下改善信号接收、降低网络能耗并加速测试模拟。

en.title: Harness-S: Training Smarter AI Agents Using Sibling Execution Environments
en.summary: Training AI agents often fails when their testing environment is too rigid. Researchers introduced **Harness-S**, a clever method that creates different variations of the testing environment—called sibling harnesses—to help the agent learn from mistakes. When the main environment fails, these alternative setups step in to guide the agent, and the learned skills are successfully **transferred back** to the original system. This approach significantly boosts performance on tough tasks like coding and database operations without needing a completely new model.

zh.title: Harness-S：利用“兄弟环境”训练更聪明的AI智能体
zh.summary: 训练AI智能体时，如果测试环境太死板，智能体经常会卡壳。研究人员推出了 **Harness-S** 方法，通过创造不同版本的“兄弟环境”来帮智能体避坑。当主环境测试失败时，这些备用环境就会来救场，并把学到的本事**内化打包**回原系统里。这招不仅让智能体在编程和数据库等复杂任务里表现大涨，还不需要费劲去换新模型。

en.title: Worktrunk: A Git Worktree CLI Built for Parallel AI Agents
en.summary: ⭐ 11,993 | Worktrunk is a command-line tool that **simplifies git worktrees** so you can easily run multiple **AI agents** at the same time without them stepping on each other's toes.

zh.title: Worktrunk：为并行 AI 代理量身定制的 Git 工作树管理工具
zh.summary: ⭐ 11,993 | Worktrunk 是一个命令行工具，它能**简化 git 工作树**的操作，让你轻松同时运行多个 **AI 代理**，而不用担心它们互相干扰。

en.title: Midterm elections deal a blow to data centers and Elon Musk
en.summary: The recent midterm elections resulted in major hurdles for tech companies, as voters across the U.S. rejected **data centers** and elected politicians who promised to restrict them. Meanwhile, massive political donations by **Elon Musk** yielded little return as his business base turned politically blue. In response to mounting grassroots backlash, companies like OpenAI are already starting to ditch secretive tactics and change their **policies**.

zh.title: 美国中期选举重挫数据中心建设与埃隆·马斯克
zh.summary: 最近的中期选举给科技公司带来了不小的麻烦，美国各地的选民纷纷投票反对**数据中心**，并选出了承诺限制其发展的政治人物。与此同时，埃隆·马斯克砸下巨资赞助政党却没捞到什么好处，其大本营的政治立场也发生了大翻转。面对越来越汹涌的基层民意，像OpenAI这样的公司已经坐不住了，开始悄悄改变**政策**以顺应形势。

en.title: Wall street suffers historic AI stock plunge
en.summary: The Nasdaq suffered its worst session since April 2025, wiping out over **$2.5 trillion** in market value. This sudden drop was triggered by political shifts and growing concerns over **AI regulation**, highlighting the sector's financial fragility and the physical limits of data centers.

zh.title: 华尔街遭遇AI股票历史性暴跌
zh.summary: 纳斯达克指数创下了2025年4月以来的最差单日表现，市值瞬间蒸发超过**2.5万亿美元**。这场暴跌是由政坛变动和对**AI监管**的担忧引发的，给狂热的行业敲响了警钟，也暴露出数据中心面临的现实阻力。

en.title: NYT Cooking AI assistant is a handy kitchen helper, but watch out for mistakes
en.summary: I tested the new AI assistant on the NYT Cooking app for ingredient swaps and recipe changes. It quickly helped me adapt a chicken recipe based on what was in my fridge and even stopped me from making weird mistakes, like putting beef in a dessert. However, it almost messed up my cake by giving me the wrong butter amount, so you still need to **double-check its work**.

zh.title: 纽约时报烹饪软件上线AI助手：改菜谱很方便，但差点毁了我的蛋糕
zh.summary: 我测试了纽约时报烹饪应用推出的全新AI助手，用它来替换食材和修改菜谱。它能根据冰箱里现有的食材快速调整鸡肉做法，甚至还能阻止我把牛肉放进甜点这种离谱操作。不过，它差点因为给错了黄油分量而毁了我的蛋糕，所以用它时你还是得**仔细核对**。

en.title: Former Vice Chairman Gen. Paul Selva on why military logistics needs AI decision-making
en.summary: Reflecting on his experience during **Hurricane Katrina** while stationed in Iraq, former Vice Chairman of the Joint Chiefs Gen. Paul Selva explained how manual data collection hampered military response, driving him to co-found **DEFCON AI**. The company develops AI software designed to help military planners optimize logistics and mobility. While this represents a growing trend of applying enterprise AI to defense operations, the actual efficacy and deployment scale of these tools remain to be **fully demonstrated** in active conflicts.

zh.title: 前美军参谋长联席会议副主席保罗·塞尔瓦：为什么军事后勤急需AI决策支持
zh.summary: 前美军参谋长联席会议副主席保罗·塞尔瓦结合自己在伊拉克期间目睹**卡特里娜飓风**救援的经历指出，过去严重依赖人工的数据收集拖慢了军事响应速度，这也是他选择联合创立**DEFCON AI**的核心原因。该公司致力于开发利用AI协助军事规划人员优化后勤与机动性的软件。尽管这反映了将人工智能应用于国防运营的行业趋势，但这些工具在实际冲突中的效能和部署规模仍有待**进一步验证**。
